mentions.name: LogiModel AI
mentions.description: This is an agentic supply chain optimization engine that forecasts demand, optimizes operations, and simulates scenarios to reduce costs while keeping the network reliable and customers satisfied. It integrates with ERP systems and document repositories to learn business context, then acts as an intelligent decision engine that handles execution so users can focus on strategy.
mentions.source_excerpt: Developing LogiModel AI (https://www.logimodel.com/) which is an agentic supply chain optimization engine that forecasts demand, optimizes operations, and simulates scenarios to reduce costs while keeping your network reliable and customers satisfied. It integrates seamlessly with your ERP and document repositories to learn your business context, then acts as an intelligent decision engine, freeing you to focus on strategy while it handles execution.
